thread:
Maria Chen: Hey folks — AcmeHealth's SIG intake asked for SSO/SAML + MFA enforcement + RBAC evidence for the POC. They want artifacts and a short narrative by EOD tomorrow. Can we assemble a minimal bundle?
James Patel: Yep. Do we want full proofpack or a trimmed sales pack?
Olivia Gomez: Trimmed sales pack is fine for initial review. I have a list ready: SSO metadata export, SAML SP metadata, MFA policy screenshot, sample RBAC policy JSON, sample service-account onboarding doc, and a snippet of audit logs (redacted).
Ben Wu: Also include a short statement on least-privilege and how delegated admin roles work. Acme will ask about role separation.
James Patel: I'll export the SAML metadata and the SSO config export from Okta. Will also grab an example conditional access policy showing MFA enforcement.
Olivia Gomez: Where should I upload? secure-share (internal) or drive?
James Patel: Use the secure artifact bucket. URL: https://files.redwood.internal/secure-artifacts/sales-pack/ (internal only)
Olivia Gomez: Cool. I'll package as: 
```
redwood_acme_poc_1831122334/
  01_sso_okta_metadata.xml  # IdP/SP metadata
  02_mfa_conditional_policy.png  # MFA screenshot
  03_rbac_example_policy.json  # sample least-privilege roles
  04_service_account_onboarding.md  # process + approvals
  05_audit_log_sample_redacted.txt  # recent auth events, redacted
  06_onepager_sig_narrative.pdf  # 1-page explainer for reviewers
```
Maria Chen: Nice. Can the one-pager include who owns IAM, where logs are retained, retention window, and contact for SOC escalation?
James Patel: Yes. I'll draft the one-pager and include KMS/HSM note and retention windows (auth logs retained 365 days, audit metadata 730 days).
Ben Wu: For RBAC example, please show both API service roles and UI roles + an example of least-privilege policy for a support engineer.
Olivia Gomez: Will do. Quick question: anything we should redact beyond emails/userids?
security-bot: Reminder: remove full user emails, tenant IDs, and any customer PII before uploading. Use internal placeholder tokens.
James Patel: Good call. I'll run the redact checklist pre-upload.
Olivia Gomez: ETA: packaging and upload in ~3 hours, then I'll ping Acme and attach link in the RFP thread.
Maria Chen: Thank you — please @me once uploaded. If anything slips, we can ask for a 24h extension but let's try to hit EOD. :thumbsup:
Ben Wu: I'll update the POC tracker with artifact link when it's up.
Maria Chen: Appreciated.
